column1: # Expected values of test_dsl_int_classes.py, written from the Intel SDM (not computed by the code under test).

# kind=ea16: columns `ea16`, encoding hex, SDM citation, address terms (registers summed, the 16-bit halves), signed displacement. The address is the sum mod 2^16 (SDM vol. 1 3.7.5 "Specifying an Offset": 16-bit addressing
#   wraps at 64 KiB); the register terms are Table 2-1 of SDM vol. 2 2.1.5 "16-Bit Addressing Forms with the ModR/M Byte".

# kind=stack: columns `stack`, encoding hex, SDM citation, esp delta (signed decimal). 66-prefixed PUSH/POP r16 move the stack pointer by 2, PUSH/POP r32 by 4 (SDM vol. 2 PUSH "Operation": StackAddrSize = 32, OperandSize 16 -> ESP - 2; POP likewise + 2).
